en: Yudhishthira replied The soul of a man is his son. The wife is his friend given by Destiny. The clouds are his principal support and charity is his best refuge.

sa: क्षत्रियः क्षत्रियं हन्ति मत्स्यो मत्स्येन जीवति। श्वा श्वानं हन्ति दाशार्ह पश्य धर्मों यथागतः॥
en: A Kshatriya kills another Kshatriya; a fish lives on another fish; a dog kills another dog. See how each follows his rule of life, O you of the Dasharha race.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तमसाभिप्लुते लोके रजसा चैव भारत। अतिष्ठन् वै मुहूर्तं तु व्यूढानीका: प्रहारिणः॥
en: Vaishampayana said O descendant of Bharata, the whole world being enshrouded in dust and natural darkness, the soldiers of both sides, without breaking the battle array, stopped for some time.

sa: सावित्र्युवाच अस्तं गते मयाऽऽदित्ये भोक्तव्यं कृतकामया। एष मे हृदि संकल्प: समयश्च कृतो मया॥
en: Savitri said : Having observed the desired vow I appointed the time when the sun would go down for my meals. (Even now) this is the determination of my heart.

sa: वध्यो भवेयं विप्रेन्द्राः शक्रस्य सह दैवतैः। एवं मे रोचते सन्धिः शक्रेण सह नित्यदा।॥
en: Shall I be capable of being slain, O chief among the Brahmanas, by Shakra, assisted by the gods. If you ordain this then shall there ever be peace with Shakra.

sa: संजय उवाच प्राप्तोऽस्मि पाण्डवान् गत्वा तं विजानीत कौरवाः। यथावयः कुरून् सर्वान् प्रतिनन्दन्ति पाण्डवाः॥
en: Sanjaya said Having gone to the Pandavas, I am returned; know you this, O sons of Kuru. The Pandus salute all the sons of Kurus, each according to his age.

sa: स्वयं राजा विषमस्थः परेषु सामर्थ्यमन्विच्छति तन्न साधु। यथाऽऽत्मनः पश्यति वृत्तमेव तथा परेषामपि सोऽभ्युपैति॥
en: The king himself in trouble wants to get strength from others; this is hardly fair. As he sees himself surrounded (by friends) so let him see others surrounded (by friends).

sa: सभाज्यमानः पौरेश्च स्त्रीभिर्जानपदैस्तथा। आसाद्य भवनद्वारं पित्रे सम्प्रत्यवेदयत्॥ ततो द्वाः स्थः प्रविश्यैव विराटमिदमब्रवीत्। बृहन्नलासहायश्च पुत्रो द्वार्युत्तरः स्थितः॥
en: He was welcomed by the citizens, females and villagers. Arrived at the gate, he sent news to his father. The waiter, approaching the king Virata said: “Your son waits at the gate with Brihannala as his help.”

sa: पाण्डवा हि यथाऽस्माकं तथा दुर्योधनो नृपः। तस्यापि क्रियतां साह्यं स पर्येति पुनः पुनः॥
en: As the sons of Pandu are to us, so is that ruler of men Duryodhana; and do you therefore help him also for he applied for it again and again.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच कल्मषं तपसो ब्रूहि श्रुतं निष्कल्मषं तपः। सनत्सुजात येनेदं विद्यां गुह्यं सनातनम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Speak about asceticism stained by fruits; I have heard all about that unstained by faults, by which, O Sanat-Sujata, I have come to know of an ancient mystery.

sa: सुयोधनो मन्युमयो महाद्रुमः स्कन्धः कर्णः शकुनिस्तस्य शाखाः। दुःशासनः पुष्पफले समृद्धे मूलं राजा धृतराष्ट्रोऽमनीषी॥
en: Suyodhana is a big tree, full of malice Karna the trunk and Shakuni the branch. Dushasana presents its numerous fruits and flowers while the wise king Dhritarashtra is the root.

sa: यस्यार्जुनः पदवीं केशवश्च वृकोदरः सात्यकोऽजातशत्रोः। माद्रीपुत्रौ सृजयाश्चापि यान्ति पुरा युद्धात् साधु तस्य प्रदानम्॥
en: He who is followed by Arjuna, Keshava, Vrikodara, Satyaki, the two sons of Madri (Nakula and Sahadeva) and Sanjaya; it is best to give up his share before the war.

sa: एतेषु सर्वेषु समागतेषु पौरेषु वृद्धेषु च संगतेषु। ब्रवीतु वाक्यं प्रणिपातयुक्तं कुन्तीसुतस्यार्थकरं यथा स्यात्॥
en: Let him all these men and also the citizens and aged men, assembled together what the son of Kunti has said with all deference and which is fraught with meaning.

sa: पितासि राजन् पुत्रास्ते वृद्धस्त्वं शिशवः परे। वर्तस्व पितृवत् तेषु वर्तन्ते ते हि पुत्रवत्॥
en: O king you are father and they are your sons. you are aged and others are children. Act therefore as befits a father and let them act as your children.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच राजा विराटोऽथ भृशाभितप्तः श्रुत्वा सुतं त्वेकरथेन यातम्। बृहन्नलासारथिमाजिवर्धनं प्रोवाच सर्वानथ मन्त्रिमुख्यान्॥
en: Hearing that his brave son had gone out with only one car and Brihannala as his charioteer, the king Virata was filled with sorrow and said to his leading ministers:

sa: या मे प्रीतिः पाण्डवेषु भूयः सा त्वयि माधव। प्रेम्णा च बहुमानाच्च सौहृदाच्च ब्रवीम्यहम्॥
en: What have I to bear to the sons of Pandu, I bear to you in a greater degree, O Madhava and I speak from motives of love, reverence and friendship.

sa: ततः सा सहसा बाला तच्छ्रुत्वा दारुणं वचः। पपात देवी व्यथिता निकृत्ता कदली यथा॥
en: That divine lady, hearing these cruel words (of Rama) was sorely afflicted with grief and suddenly fell down (to the ground) like a plantain tree torn up by the roots.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच का तु सीमन्तिनी त्वादृक् लोकेष्वस्ति पितृष्वसः। शूरस्य राज्ञो दुहिता आजमीढकुलं गता।॥
en: Vasudeva said O aunt, what woman is there in this world who is like you? The daughter of king Shura, you now (by marriage) a member of the Ajamida race.

sa: शृङ्गाटकेषु सर्वेषु आख्यातुं विजयं मम॥ उत्तरा च कुमारीभिर्बह्वीभिः परिवारिता। शृङ्गारवेषाभरणा प्रत्युद्यातुं सुतं मम॥
en: Announce my victory at the meeting of the four roads. Let Uttara, too, encircled by many princesses, dressed and adorned in a charming style, go out to receive my son.

sa: शिखराणां समृद्धानामुपरिष्टात् समन्ततः । वायसाश्च रुवन्त्युग्रं वामं मण्डलमाश्रिताः॥ पक्वापक्वेति सुभृशं वावाश्यन्ते वयांसि च।
en: From the top of tall trees crows fly away in circles from the left. They are ultering terrible cries. All of them are sending forth fearful cries of pakka, pakka.

sa: धर्मादपेता ये चान्ये मया नात्रानुकीर्तिताः। ये चानुकीर्तितास्तेषां गतिं क्षिप्रमवाप्नुयाम्॥ यदि व्युष्टामिमां रात्रिं श्वो न हन्यां जयद्रथम्।
en: The ends of all those wretched persons whom I have not enumerated, as also of those whom I have here mentioned, shall soon overtake me, if, after this night passing away, I do not slay Jayadratha tomorrow.

sa: मामैरिति समं सर्वे स्वस्ति तेऽस्त्विति चासकृत्। ततस्तेषामहं वाग्भिस्तर्पितः सहसोत्थितः। मातरं सरिता श्रेष्ठामपश्यं रथमास्थिताम्॥
en: "Fear not, you will still be prosperous" and I suddenly stood up, comforted at those words of theirs, and saw my mother, the best among river, seated on the car.

sa: सा कन्या तपसा तेन देहार्धेन व्यजायत। नदी च राजन् वत्सेषु कन्या चैवाभवत् तदा॥
en: O king, by merit of her austerities that maiden became a river by only half her body, while by the other half she remained a maiden in Vatsabhumi, as before.

sa: ते तु क्रुद्धा महेष्वासा द्रौपदेयाः प्रहारिणः। राक्षसं दुद्रुवुः संख्ये ग्रहाः पञ्च रविं यथा।॥
en: Thereat inflamed with rage, the sons of Draupadi, all mighty bowmen accomplished in smiting down the foe, rushed against the Rakshasas, like the five planets rushing at the a sun.

sa: पार्थस्तु विष्टभ्य बलेन पादौ भीष्मान्तिकं तूर्णमभिद्रवन्तम्। बलान्निजग्राह हरि किरीटी पदेऽथ राजन् दशमे कथञ्चित्॥
en: The high-souled Partha, however, seized with great force his legs as he was rushing towards Bhishma; O king, he succeeded in stopping him with great difficulty on the tenth step.

sa: किंचित् कालान्तरे दास्ये पुल्लिङ्ग स्वमिदं तव। आगन्तव्यं त्वया काले सत्यं चैव वदस्व मे॥
en: I will bestow upon you my own manhood, for a certain period. But, (after its lapse) you will have to come in (due) time. Now, speak the truth to me.

sa: आश्वासन स्नुषां राज्ञि मा शुचः क्षत्रिये भृशम्। श्वः प्रियं सुमहच्छ्रुत्वा विशोका भव नन्दिनि॥
en: O queen, comfort your daughter-in-law; () daughter of a Kshatriya, do not lament, Dismiss your sorrow, O my beloved sister, as in the morrow you will hear such agreeable news.

sa: व्यास उवाच शैब्यस्य नृपतेः पुत्रः सृञ्जया नाम नामतः। सखायौ तस्य चैवोभौ ऋषी पर्वतनारदौ॥
en: There lived in days gone by, a king known by the name of Srinjaya. He had a son who was named Shaivya; the sages Parvata and Narada were his friends.

sa: ततो दिशः सोऽनुदिशश्च पार्थः शरैः सुधारैः समरे वितत्य। गाण्डीवशब्देन मनांसि तेषां किरीटमाली व्यथयाञ्चकार॥
en: Those arrows from Partha's bow cut off the arins, bows, standard-tops and cars, penetrated into the ranks of the kings and of the huge elephants and horses of the enemy.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच स एव मे वरः शल्य उद्योगे यस्त्वया कृतः। सूतपुत्रस्य संग्रामे कार्यस्तेजोवधस्त्वया॥
en: Yudhishthira said O Shalya, this was the boon I asked during the preparations for this battle. The prowess of the Suta's son (Karna) should be weakened by you in battle.

sa: तेषां रथानामथ पृष्ठगोपा द्वात्रिंशदन्येऽभ्यपतन्त पार्थम्। तथैव ते तं परिवार्य पार्थं विकृष्य चापानि महारवाणि॥
en: Then thirty two of those car-warriors, protecting his (Trigarta king's) rear, rushed at the son of Pritha. Thereafter those warriors encircled Pritha's son and drawing their bows emitting fierce twangs,

sa: दृष्टमेतत् पुरा देवैर्गमिष्यति यमक्षयम्। यद् दृष्टं हि पुरा पार्थ तत् तथा न तदन्यथा॥
en: It have been foredoomed, O Partha by the gods that Bhishma shall go to the abode of Death. That must come to pass which has been destined by the gods.

sa: संजय उवाच स कर्णे कर्णिना कर्णे पुनर्विव्याध फाल्गुनिः। शरैः पञ्चाशता चैनमविध्यत् कोपयन् भृशम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Once more did the son of Arjuna pierced Karna on his car, with barbed arrows and then for angering the latter, again pierced him with fifty shafts more.

sa: नारद उवाच शिबिमौशीनरं चापि मृतं सृञ्जय शुश्रुम। य इमां पृथिवीं सर्वां चर्मवत् पर्यवेष्टयत्॥
en: Narada said We heard, O Srinjaya, that even Sini, the son of Ushinara, had to sutfer death, who had put, as it were, a leathern band round the entire earth.

sa: न चापि गमने शक्ति काश्चित् पश्यामि चिन्तयन्। सोऽस्मि नेयः सदा ताता नदीकूलमितः परम्॥
en: I have not the slightest power to move, I now see on reflection; therefore should I be taken every day hence to the river side by you, my dear friends.

sa: संजय उवाच राजन् सुबहवो द्वीपा यैरिदं सततं जगत्। सप्तद्वीपान् प्रवक्ष्यामि चन्द्रादित्यौ ग्रहं तथा॥
en: Sanjaya said O king, there are many islands in this earth. But I shall describe to you only seven islands and also the moon, and the sun and the planets.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान् देवान् सर्षिगणान् पुरा। विसृज्य सर्वभूतात्मा जगाम भवनं स्वकम्॥
en: Bhishma said That almighty one (the Grandsire), having thus spoken to the gods and the sages in the days of yore, repaired to his own residence' leaving all creatures behind.

sa: तव प्रसादाद् भगवान् किं नावाप्तं रणे मम। अविषह्यं हृषीकेश किं जानन् मां विगर्हसे॥
en: Through your grace, O almighty one, what is there unacquirable by me in battle? O Hrishikesha, knowing my prowess to be incapable of being baffled, why do you admonish me?

sa: स्थास्यते रक्षितो वीरैः सिंधुराट् स सुदुर्मदः। धनुष्यस्त्रे च वीर्ये च प्राणे चैव तथौरसे॥
en: There will the invincible king of the Sindhus stand, being protected by those heroes. In handling the bow and other weapons, in prowess, in might and in their high extraction.

sa: भीमः सप्त शतान् वीराननयद् यमसादनम्। पुनश्चैव द्विसाहस्रान् कलिङ्गानरिमर्दनः॥ प्राहिणोन्मृत्युलोकाय तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्। एवं स तान्यनीकानि कलिङ्गानां पुनः पुनः॥ बिभेद समरे तूर्णं प्रेक्ष्य भीष्मं महारथम्। हतारोहाश्च मातङ्गाः पाण्डवेन कृता रणे॥ विप्रजग्मुरनीकेषु मेघा वातहता इव। मृद्गन्तः स्वान्यनीकानि विनदन्तः शरातुराः॥
en: Bhima then killed seven hundred heroes; that chastiser of foes then sent two thousand Kalingas to the region of Death. It was a wonderful feat; it was thus that the heroic and the fearfully strong Bhima again and again killed in that battle a very large number of the Kalingas. Elephants were deprived of their riders by that son of Pandu. Afflicted with arrows they roved about the field, treading down innumerable troops and uttering roars like those of the clouds.

sa: स एष सर्वं सुरमर्त्यलोकं समुद्रकक्ष्यान्तरितां पुरीं च। युगे युगे मानुषं चैव वासं पुनः पुनः सृजते वासुदेवः॥
en: It is that Vasudeva the creator of the universe who does repeatedly create, Yuga after Yuga, all the regions of the celestials and the mortals, all the sea-girt cities, and also all the regions of human habitation.

sa: इत्युक्तोऽयं मया धर्मः संक्षिप्तो ब्रह्मनिर्मितः। धर्माधर्मो हि लोकस्य यो वै वेत्ति स बुद्धिमान्॥
en: I have now described to you briefly the duties laid down by Brahman. He, indeed, in an intelligent men who knows what is righteousness and its opposite in this world.

sa: बुद्धिं तमसि सक्तां तमो रजसि संश्रितम्। रजः सत्त्वे तथा सक्तं सत्त्वं सक्तं तथाऽऽत्मनि॥
en: The Understanding has its refuge in Darkness; Darkness has Ignorance for its refuge; Rajas is founded upon the quality of goodness and quality of Goodness is attached to the Soul.

sa: न संत्यजन्त्यात्मकर्म यो न जीर्यति जीर्यतः। यो न पूरयितुं शक्यो लोभः प्राप्त्या कुरूद्वह॥
en: Like the ocean that can never be filled by the continued flow of even numberless rivers of immeasurable depths, covetousness is incapable of being conquered by any number of acquisitions.

sa: राजोवाच कृतं सर्वेण भद्रं ते जप्यं यद् याचितं मया। स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु गमिष्यामि किञ्च तस्य फलं वद॥
en: The king said Blessed be you, I have no necessity for the fruits of your recitations which I have begged. Blessings on your head. I am about to leave you. Tell me, however, what those fruits are.

sa: सांख्यं विशालं परमं पुराणं महार्णवं विमलमुदारकान्तम्। कृत्स्नं च सांख्यं नृपते महात्मा नारायणो धारयतेऽप्रमेयम्॥
en: That great person who is fully conversant with the vast, high, ancient, oncean-like, and immeasurable Sankhya system who is pure and liberal and agreeable, becomes, O king, equal to Narayana.

sa: व्यास उवाच एत् ते वर्तयिष्यामि यथावदनुपूर्वशः। शृणु तत् त्वमिहैकाग्रो यथातत्त्वं यथा च तत्॥
en: Vyasa said I shall explain this to you properly, one after another. Listen with rapt attention to the subject as I explain how what I have said actually takes place.

sa: पुत्राणां वे शते ब्रह्मन् कालेन विनिपातिते। अहं राजाभवं विप्र तत्र पूर्वं शतं मम॥
en: These were begotten by me after my own form, O best of twiceborn persons! On one occasion I went on a hunting expedition, Stupefied, I travelled amidst a thick forest.

sa: जनक उवाच वर्णो विशेषवर्णानां महर्षे केन जायते। एतदिच्छाम्यहं ज्ञातुं तद् ब्रूहि वदतां वरा॥
en: Janaka said Whence, O great Rishi, does this difference of colour arise among men of the different orders? I wish to know this. Tell me this, O foreinost of speakers.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच स्वाध्याये कृतयत्नस्य नरस्य च पितामह। धर्मकामस्य धर्मात्मन् किं नु श्रेय इहोच्यते॥
en: Yudhishthira said O grandfather, O you of virtuous soul, what, indeed, yields great merit for a person assiduously engaged in the study of the Vedas and desirous of gaining virtue.

sa: जनक उवाच ब्रह्मणैकेन जातानां नानात्वं गोत्रतः कथम्। बहूनीह हि लोके वै गोत्राणि मुनिसत्तम॥
en: Janka said When all have originated from Brahman alone, how did human beings become divergent of race? O best of ascetics, numberless diversity of races is seen in this world.

sa: शब्दं न विन्देच्छ्रोत्रेण स्पर्श त्वचा न वेदयेत्। रूपं न चक्षुषा विद्याज्जिह्वया न रसांस्तथा॥
en: He has no perception of sound through the car; no perception of touch through the skin no perception of from through the eye; no perception of taste through the tongue.

sa: दम्पत्योः प्राणसंश्लेषे योऽभिसंधिः कृतः किल। तं माता च पिता चेति भूतार्थो मातरि स्थितः॥
en: When husband and wife unite themselves for procreation, the desire for a son is cherished by both, but about its fruition more depends upon the mother than on the father.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच आचारस्य विधिं तात प्रोच्यमानं त्वयानघ। श्रोतुमिच्छामि धर्मज्ञ सर्वज्ञो ह्यसि मे मतः॥
en: I think, O grandfather, that you know everything. O you, who are conversant with duties, I wish to hear you describe to me, O sinless one, the ordinances about conduct.

sa: देवतेयं गृहस्यास्य शापात् किं नु विरूपिता। अस्याश्च कारणं वेत्तुं न युक्तं सहसा मया॥
en: This lady is forsooth, the mistress of this palace. Has she been made ugly through some curse! It is not proper that I should quickly determine the cause of this.

sa: नास्ति सत्यात् परो धर्मो नानृतात् पातकं परम्। स्थितिर्हि सत्यं धर्मस्य तस्मात्सत्यं न लोपयेत्॥
en: There is no duty which is higher than Truth, and no sin more dreadful than untruth. Indeed, Truth is the very root of righteousness. Therefore one should never destroy Truth.

sa: ते च पूर्वं सुराश्चेति द्विविधाः पितरः स्मृताः। त्वष्टश्चैवात्मजः श्रीमान् विश्वरूपो महायशाः॥ अजैकपादहिर्बुध्न्यो विरूपाक्षोऽथ रैवतः। हरश्च बहुरूपश्च त्र्यम्बकश्च सुरेश्वरः॥ सावित्रश्च जयन्तश्च पिनाकी चापराजितः। पूर्वमेव महाभागा वसवोऽष्टौ प्रकीर्तिताः॥
en: These were called first gods and the two classes of departed manes. Tashtri had many sons. Amongst them were the beautiful and famous Visharupa. Ajaikapat, Ahi, Bradhna, Virupaksha, and Raivata. Then there were Hara and Vahurupa, Tryamyaka the chief of the Deities, and Savitrya, Jayanta and Pinaki the invincible. The highly blessed eight Vasus have formerly been enumerated by me.

sa: सगर उवाच किं श्रेयः परमं ब्रह्मन् कृत्वेह सुखमश्नुते। कथं न शोचेन्न क्षुभ्येदेतदिच्छामि वेदितुम्॥
en: Sagara said What is that good, O Brahmana, by doing which one may enjoy happiness here? How, indeed, may one avoid grief and agitation? I wish to know all this.

sa: येन लोकास्त्रयः सृष्टा दैत्याः सर्वाश्च देवताः। स एष भगवान् विष्णुः समुद्रे तप्यते तपः॥
en: Even he, the worshipful Vishnu, who created the three worlds with the Daityas and all the gods, even He is engaged in austere penances in the heart of the deep.

sa: मानुषाणां कुतः स्नेहो येषां शोको भविष्यति। इमं कुलकरं पुत्रं त्यक्त्वा क्व न गमिष्यथ॥
en: How is affection to be seen in human beings since they only indulge in grief? Where would you go leaving here this child who is the perpetuator of his family.

sa: मम चापि पिता तात कथयामास शान्तनुः॥ ततो मयापि श्रुत्वा च कीर्तितं तव भारत।
en: I heard it from my father Shantanu, O son, who recited it to me formerly. Myself having heard it from my father, I have repeated it to you, O Bharata.

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्तो जनको राजन् याथातथ्यं मनीषिणा। श्रुत्वा धर्मविदां श्रेष्ठः परां मुदमवाप ह॥
en: Bhishma continued Thus addressed agreeably to the truth by the sage, Janaka, that foremost of pious men, O king, heard everything the Rishi said and acquired great happiness from it.

sa: तस्य प्रियं करिष्यामि स हि मामाश्रितः सदा। भ्राता मे बान्धवश्चासौ सखा च हृदयङ्गमः॥
en: I must do as my friend desires me. He is very intimate with me. He is my brother, and a dear relative. He is, indeed a friend, of my heart.

sa: अग्निरुवाच मम मोक्षस्य कोऽन्तो वै ब्रह्मन् ध्यायस्व वै प्रभो। एतदिच्छामि विज्ञातुं तत्त्वतो लोकपूजित॥
en: How shall I be saved from her, O Brahman? O powerful Lord, do you appoint the way. I wish to know the means fully, O worshipped of all the worlds.

sa: कृच्छ्राणि चीर्वा च ततो यथोक्तानि द्विजोत्तमैः। तीर्थानि चापि गत्वा वै दानानि विविधानि च॥
en: He observed many rigid and severe vows as laid down by the foremost of Brahmanas. He sojourned to many sacred waters and made many gifts to Brahmanas in those places.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच न रोचये स्वर्गवासं विना देहमहं विभो। गच्छ धर्म न मे श्रद्धा स्वर्गं गन्तुं विनाऽऽत्मना॥
en: The Brahmana said I do not, O powerful lord, wish to live in heaven itself without this body of mine. Leave, me, O Dharma. I have no desire to go. to heaven itself without my own body.

sa: धर्म उवाच अलं देहे मनः कृत्वा त्यक्त्वा देहं सुखी भव। गच्छ लोकानरजसो यत्र गत्वा न शोचसि॥
en: Dharma said Without setting your heart on your body, cast it off and be happy. Go into regions that are free from the quality of Ignorance. Indeed, going there, you shall never have to experience any misery.

sa: प्रजापतिरुवाच न कुप्ये न च मे कामो न भवेयुः प्रजा इति। लाघवार्थं धरण्यास्तु ततः संहार इष्यते॥
en: The lord of all created beings said, I am not angry, nor is it my desire that all the create beings should perish. It is only for lightening the lord of the Earth that destruction is desirable.

sa: स्वागतं ते महाराज ब्रूहि यद् यदिहेच्छसि। स्वशक्त्या किं करोमीह तद् भवान् प्रब्रवीतु माम्।।३८।
en: You welcome, 0 great king. communicate to me all your wishes. Let your noble self tell me what I shall have to do for you by putting forth my might,

sa: ततस्तु सात्यकी यत्नेन तु सदा पार्थ योद्धव्यो धृतराष्ट्रजः॥ कृती च बलवांश्चैव युद्धशौण्डश्च नित्यदा।
en: You should however, O son of Pritha, always fight with care with the son of Dhritarashtra. He is endued with both skill and strength and always finds delight in battle.

sa: संजय उवाच नकुलं रभसं युद्धे निघ्नतं वाहिनी तव। अभ्ययात् सौबलः क्रुद्धस्तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Sanjaya said The son of Subala (i.e. Shakuni), excited with wrath, rushed against Nakula who was slaughtering your troops with (great) impetuosity in battle and said (to him) “Wait, wait."

sa: यो हि धर्मः स विदुरो विदुरो यः स पाण्डवः। स एष राजन् दृश्यस्ते पाण्डवः प्रेष्यवत् स्थितः॥२१
en: He who is Dharma, is Vidura and he who is Vidura is the (eldest) son of Pandu. That son of Pandu, O king, is capable of being perceived by you. He is before you as your servitor.

sa: इयं च बृहती श्यामा तथात्यायतलोचना। वृथा सभातले क्लिष्टा मा भूदिति च तत् कृतम्॥
en: I acted thus in order that this lady of welldeveloped forms and of large eyes might not suffer the wrongs inflicted on her in the public hall without being avenged.

sa: कर्ण कर्ण वृथादृष्टे सूतपुत्र वचः शृणु। सदा स्पर्धसि संग्रामे फाल्गुनेन तरस्विना॥ तथास्मान् बाधसे नित्यं धार्तराष्ट्रमते स्थितः।
en: O Karna, O son of a charioteer, O you of vain seeing, hear my words, You always challenge in fight Phalguna of quick speed. Abiding by the counsel of the son of Dhritarashtra you always obstruct us.

sa: मृतस्य कीर्त्या किं कार्यं भस्मीभूतस्य देहिनः। मृतः कीर्ति न जानीते जीवन कीर्तिं समश्नुते॥
en: As regards a dead person whose frame has been reduced to ashes, what necessity is there for fame? It is not the dead but living persons that can enjoy fame.

sa: हंस उवाच अज्ञानेनावृतो लोको मात्सर्यान्न प्रकाशते। लोभात् त्यजति मित्राणि संगात् स्वर्ग न गच्छति॥
en: The world is covered by Ignorance. Men fail to shine on account of malice. People renounce friends, actuated by covetousness. Men fail to attain to heaven on account of attachment.

sa: उवाच चैन मधुरं नृपं शान्तनवो नृपः। प्रविशस्व पुरीं राजन् व्येतु ते मानसो ज्वरः॥
en: Addressing his grandson in a sweet voice, the royal son of Shantanu, also said, Do you return to your city, O king, Let the fever of your heart be removed.

sa: भीष्म उवाच तस्यां निशायां व्युष्टायां गते तस्मिन् द्विजोत्तमे। निष्क्रम्य गौतमोऽगच्छत् समुद्रं प्रति भारत॥
en: Bhishma said After the expiration of that night, and that best of Brahmanas had left the house, Gautama issuing from his house, began to proceed towards the sea, O Bharata.

sa: प्रियैः समागमं तेषां यः सम्यक् शृणुयान्नरः। प्रियाणि लभते नित्यमिह च प्रेत्य चैव सः॥
en: That man who duly listens to this discourse meets with everything that is dear to him. Indeed, he obtains all agreeable objects both in this world and in the next.

sa: त्यज्यन्ते दुःखमर्था हि पालने न च ते सुखाः। दुःखेन चाधिगम्यते नाशमेषां न चिन्तयेत्॥
en: There is pain in spending wealth. There is pain in protecting it. There is pain in acquiring it. Hence, when one's wealth is lost, he should not grieve for it.

sa: भूयिष्ठं विजिता दोषा निहताः सर्वशत्रवः। एको दोषो वरिष्ठश्च वध्यः स न हतो मया॥
en: I have controlled many faults. I have slain all enemies. But there is one, the greatest, vice which deserves to be destroyed but which has not been destroyed be me.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच त्रयो वै रिपवो लोके नवधा गुणतः स्मृताः। प्रहर्षः प्रीतिरानन्दस्त्रयस्ते सात्त्विका गुणाः॥
en: The Brahmana said There are three enemies in the world. They are said to be minefield, according to their qualities. Exultation, satisfaction, and joy, these three qualities belong to Goodness.

sa: विमानमास्थाय महानुभावः श्रिया च संहृष्टतनुर्नृपोत्तमः। आमन्त्र्य पुत्रौ सह सीतया च जगाम देवप्रवरस्य लोकम्॥
en: Having advised his two sons along with Sītā, ascending the car, and shining in his effulgence, that excellent king, greatly delighted, repaired to the region of the king of celestials.

sa: दृश्यते हि कुले जातो दर्शनीयः प्रतापवान्। दुःखं जीवन् सहामात्यो भवितव्यं हि तत् तथा॥
en: It is seen that some one of nobly born highly beautiful and powerful, lives in misery, with all his counsellors and friends. This happens because it has been so ordained.

sa: संजय उवाच तद् बलं सुमहद् दीर्णं त्वदीयं प्रेक्ष्य वीर्यवान्। दधारैको रणे राजन् वृषसेनोऽस्त्रमायया॥
en: Sanjaya said Seeing that army of yours thoroughly routed in battle, O monarch, Vrishasena endued with prowess, single-handed, began to protect it by means of the illusion of this weapons.

sa: अनृतं नोक्तपूर्वं मे न च वक्ष्ये कदाचन॥ कृच्छ्रेष्वपि गतः सौम्य क्षत्रधर्मेण ते शपे।
en: I have never before told an untruth; and I swear by my Ksatriya morality, that albeit fallen on evil days, I will never do so in future, O gentle one.

sa: तु राजोवाच पुत्रि प्रदानकालस्ते न च कश्चिद् वृणोति माम्। स्वयमन्विच्छ भर्तारं गुणैः सदृशमात्मनः॥
en: The king said: Daughter, the time for giving you away is arrived. (But) none asks me (for your hand). Do you, (therefore) seek for a husband as qualified as you.

sa: स नागः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा वेपमानो नलं तदा। उवाच मां विद्धि राजन् नागं कर्कोटकं नृप।॥ मया प्रलब्धो ब्रह्मर्षिर्नारदः सुमहातपाः। तेन मन्युपरीतेन शप्तोऽस्मि मनुजाधिप।॥ तिष्ठ त्वं स्थावर इव यावदेव नल: क्वचित्। इतो नेता हि तत्र त्वं शापान्मोक्ष्यसि मत्कृतात्॥
en: Thereupon the Naga (the king of the snakes), with folded hands and trembling with fear, addressed Nala. 'O king! know me that I am Naga (snake), Karkotaka by name. O lord of men! the great sage, Narada, observing rigid austerity, was once deceived by me; and who, again, filled with rage, coursed me, saying: Remain here like some immovable thing, until king Nala leads you hence. And, indeed, wherever shall he take you, there shall you be released from my curse.'

sa: एष ते सर्पसंकाशो बाणः पास्यति शोणितम्। मृगराज इव क्रुद्धो नागराजस्य शोणितम्। इत्येवमुक्त्वा संक्रुद्धः शरं धनुषि संदधे॥
en: Even as a lion enraged shedded the blood of a mighty elephant, this arrow of mine resembling a serpent shall shed your blood. Having delivered himself thus, he fired with wrath set his shaft on his bow.

sa: पाण्डुरुवाच शत्रूणां या वधे वृत्तिः सा मृगाणां वधे स्मृता। राज्ञां मृग न मां मोहात् त्वं गर्हयितुमर्हसि॥
en: Pandu said : O deer, kings behave in the matter of killing the animals of your species (deer) as they do in the matter of killing their foes. Therefore, you should not, reprove me out of ignorance.

sa: यदा तु भवन्ति भेदा ज्ञातीनां कलहाश्च वृकोदर। प्रसक्तानि च वैराणि कुलधर्मो न नश्यति॥
en: O Vrikodara, dissensions and disputes often take place among those that are connected in blood. Such hostilities always exist, but for it family honour is never suffered to be destroyed.

sa: षष्ठमध्ययनं नाम तेषां कस्मिन् प्रतिष्ठितः। हतो द्रोणो मया ह्येवं किं मां पार्थ विगर्हसे॥
en: The sixth duty is study. To which of these six was that Drona who has been slain by me devoted? Wherefore then do you reproach me, O son of Pritha?

sa: उतथ्य उवाच धर्माय राजा भवति न कामकरणाय तु। मान्धातरिति जानीहि राजा लोकस्य रक्षिता॥
en: Utatthya said One becomes a king for advancing the cause of virtue and not for acting capriciously. Know this, O Mandhatri; the king is, indeed, the protector of the world.

sa: भरताद् भारती कीर्तिर्यनदं भारतं कुलम्। अपरे ये च पूर्वे वै भारता इति विश्रुता॥
en: From this Bharata has followed this, "achievement of Bharata," from him has sprung this great race (of Bharata.) All kings that were born after him are called after his name.

sa: ऋते च विदुरात् सर्वे यूयं वध्या मता मम। धृतराष्ट्रस्तु धर्मज्ञो न वध्यः कुरुसत्तमः॥
en: That with the exception of Vidura, will you be slain, is my opinion; and Dhritarashtra, who knows the nature of virtue-that best one among the Kurus cannot possibly be slain.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच भरद्वाजं कथं युद्धे युयुधानो न्यवारयत्। संजयाचक्ष्व तत्त्वेन परं कौतुहलं हि मे॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Tell me in detail, O Sanjaya, how did Yuyudhana oppose in battle the son of Bharadvaja? I feel a great curiosity for knowing what happened then. Sanjaya said

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तं विशोध्य तदा राजा देवदूतेन भारत। हृष्टः प्रमुदितश्चापि प्रतिजग्राह तं सुतम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O descendant of the Virata race, the king was exceedingly pleased, because the purity of the birth of his son was established by the messenger of heaven.

sa: कणिक उवाच एवं तेषु प्रयातेषु जम्बुको हृष्टमानसः। खादति स्म तदा मांसमेकः सन् मन्त्रनिश्चयात्॥
en: Kanika said: When thus they all went away, the jackal was much pleased in his heart for the success of policy and he alone ate the flesh (of that deer).

sa: स तेन राज्ञातिरथेन विद्धो विगाहमानो ध्वजिनी कुरूणाम्। शतपं पञ्चभिराशु विद्धा 'ततोऽस्य सूतं दशभिर्जघान॥
en: Then wounded by that king a mighty carwarrior and drowned as it were in the Kuru army he wounded Shatruntapa with five arrows and then killed his charioteer with ten.

sa: तमाहुरार्ता ऋषयो महर्षि न ते वयं पुष्करं चोरयामः। मिथ्याभिषङ्गो भवता न कार्य: शपाम तीक्ष्णैः शपथैर्महर्षे ॥
en: The Rishis, much concerned at what he said, addressed that great ascetic and said-We have not stolen your stalks! You should not cherish these suspicions against us, O great Rishi, we shall take the most dreadful oaths.

sa: पुरा च राजर्षिवरेण धीमता बहूनि वर्षाण्यमितेन तेजसा। प्रकृष्टमेतत् कुरुणा महात्मना ततः कुरुक्षेत्रमितीह पप्रथे॥
en: That foremost of royal sages, viz., the great, intelligent and energetic Kuru, had cultivated this field for many years. Hence it came to be called Kurukshetra (the field of Kuru)!"

sa: ज्ञानवृद्धा मया राजन् बहवः पर्युपासिताः। तेषां कथयतां शौरेरहं गुणवतो गुणान्॥ समागतानामश्रौषं बहून् बहुमतान् सताम्। कर्माण्यपि च यान्यस्य जन्मप्रभृति धीमतः॥ बहुशः कथ्यमानानि नरैर्भूयः श्रुतानि मे। न केवलं वयं कामाच्चेदिराज जनार्दनम्॥
en: O king, I have worshipped many men who are old in knowledge. I have heard from all those wise men when they came and talked to me what are the many accomplishments of Shauri (Krishna). I have heard many times narrated by the people all the acts which greatly intelligent Krishna performed since his birth. O king of Chedi, we do not worship Janardana only from caprice,

sa: एतैः शरीरैर्जलमेव गत्वा जलाच्च तेजः पवनोऽन्तरिक्षम् खाद् वै निवर्तन्ति न भाविनस्ते मोक्षं च ते वै परमाप्नुवन्ति॥
en: The bodies of all (earthly) objects, thence to light or heat, thence to the wind, and thence to space. The who seek liberation have not to return from space. On the other hand, they attain to Brahma.

sa: इत्येव ते तद् वनमाविशन्तो महत्यरण्ये मृगयां चरित्वा। बालामपश्यन्त तदा रुदन्ती धात्रेयिकां प्रेष्यवधू प्रियायाः॥
en: Having given up the chase they in that great forest entered the grove containing their hermitage and there they saw their beloved one's maid, the girl Dhatreyika weeping and sobbing.

sa: स हस्तिनेवाभिहतो गजेन्द्रः प्रगृह्य भल्लान् निशितान् निषङ्गात्। आकर्णपूर्णं च धनुर्विकृष्य विव्याध गात्रेष्वथ सूतपुत्रम्॥
en: He covered Karna's car with shafts like the sun covering the regions with its rays. Like a lion attacked by an elephant he, taking out sharpened arrows from the quiver.

sa: अनुप्रवेशे यद् वीर कृतवांस्त्वं मम प्रियम्। सर्वं तदनुजानामि व्यलीकं न च मे हृदि॥
en: O hero, I know full well why you entered the room and did what you thought would be disagreeable to me. But I have not felt any displeasure for it.

sa: अथाशुकारी चतुरो हयांश्च विव्याध को निशितैः किरीटिनः। त्रिभिश्च यन्तारममृष्यमाणो विव्याध तूर्णं त्रिभिरस्य केतुम्॥
en: The two, stationed on cars, appeared to men like the sun and the moon covered by clouds. Then the light-handed and intelligent Karna wounded the horses of Partha with shafts,

sa: भक्षितायां हि वैदेह्यां हृतायामपि लक्ष्मण। के हि लोके प्रियं कर्तुं शक्तः सौम्य ममेश्वराः॥
en: O Lakşmaņa, while virtue did not protect Janakī being devoured or taken away by stealth, what person else gifted with heavenly power, on this earth shall bring about my well-being?

sa: तस्या नद्यास्तु तीरे वै सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः। विश्वेदेवाः समरुतो गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्च ह। द्वैपायनः शुकश्चैव कृष्णाश्च मधुसूदनः। यक्षाश्च राक्षसाश्चैव पिशाचाश्च विशाम्पते॥ एते चान्ये च बहवो योगसिद्धाः सहस्रशः। तस्मिंस्तीर्थे सरस्वत्याः शिवे पुण्ये परंतप॥ तत्र हत्वा पुरा विष्णुरसुरौ मधुकैटभौ। आप्लुत्य भरतश्रेष्ठ तीर्थप्रवर उत्तमे॥
en: There, in that Tirtha situate on the bank of that river, all the gods with Vasava at their head, the Vishvedevas, the Maruts, the Gandharvas, the Apsaras, the Island-born Vyasa, Shuka, Krishna the slayer of Madhu, the Yakshas, the Rakshasas and the Pisachas, O king and various others. thousands in numbers, all crowned with ascetic success, always live. Indeed, in that auspicious and sacred Tirtha of the Sarasvati, Vishnu himself having in days of yore slain the Asuras, Madhu and Kaitabha, had, O chief of the Bharatas, performed his ablutions.

sa: वाङ्मतिभ्यां हि सर्वेषां करिष्यामि प्रियं हि वः॥ यद्धि दाशरथेः कार्यं मम तन्नात्र संशयः।
en: I will do what is agreeable to you by my words and my and my intention. That which is Dasarathi's work is also mine. Of this there is no doubt.

sa: त्यक्त्वा राज्यं च मानं च भोगांश्च विविधान् बहून्। तपस्वी नियताहारः शेते शीते महीतले॥
en: And forsaking kingdom, and dignity, and the many and various enjoyments, Bharata practising asceticism and restraining himself in respect of food, in this winter lie down on the bare earth.

sa: एता वाचो मनुष्याणां ग्रामसंवासवासिनाम्। शृण्वन्नतिययौ वीरः कोसलान् कोसलेश्वरः॥ ततो वेदश्रुतिं नाम शिववारिवहां नदीम्। उत्तीर्याभिमुखः प्रायादगस्त्याध्युषितां दिशम्॥
en: Hearing these words of the villagers, that hero, the lord of Kosala, left Kosala behind him. Then crossing the river Vedaśruti of sacred waters, Rāma went in the direction of the quarter in which Agastya resided. (South)

sa: स राघवः सत्यधृतिश्च लक्ष्मणो महानुभावो भरतश्च धार्मिकः। वृताः सुहृद्भिश्च विरेचिरेऽध्वरे यथा सदस्यैः सहितात्रयोऽग्नयः॥
en: And Rāghava having truth and forbearance, and Lakşmaņa endowed with magnanimity, and Bharata possessed of righteousness, surrounded by their friends, appeared (there) like to the three fires surrounded by Sadasyas.

sa: इतीव तं शोकविधेयदेह रामं विसंज्ञं विलपन्तमेव। उवाच सौमित्रिरदीनसत्त्वो न्याय्ये स्थितः कालयुतं च वाक्यम्॥
en: After Rāma had bewailed thus being beside himself with grief, Saumitrī, ever treading the right path and not of poorly mind spoke words worthy of being said on that occasion.

sa: इक्ष्वाकूणां त्वया तुल्यं सुहृदं नोपलक्षये। यथा दशरथो राजा मां न शोचेत् तथा कुरु॥
en: I do not find any one that is a friend of the sons of Ikşvāku like to you. Do you so act that king Dasaratha may not grieve (for me.)

sa: माता ते पितरं देवि पुनः केकयमब्रवीत्। शंस मे जीव वा मा वा न मां त्वं प्रहसिष्यसि॥
en: But that revered one, your mother, again urged Kekaya, saying, 'Tell it to me, whether you live or die; for (when I have learnt all about it), you will not be able to laugh at me again.

sa: आनुपूर्त्यां च वृत्तं तल्लाङ्गलं रोममिश्रितम्। उत्पतिष्यन् विचिक्षेप पक्षिराज इवोरगम्॥ तस्य लाङ्गलमाविद्धमतिवेगस्य पृष्टतः। ददृशे गरुडेनेव ह्रियमाणो महोरगः॥
en: He lashed his roundish tail covered with down and again on his back just to get ready for the spring. It seemed as if Garuda, the king of the birds, was flying off with a huge snake.

sa: नृशंसे दुष्टचारित्रे कुलस्यास्य विनाशिनि ॥ किं कृतं तव रामेण पापे पापं मयापि वा।
en: You cruel one! You of vile ways! You destroyer of this race! O wicked woman, what has been done by Räma to you; or what wrong have I done you?

sa: श्रुतश्च मन्ये वैदेह्या स स्वरः सदृशो मम। त्रस्तया प्रेषितस्त्वं च द्रष्टुं मां शीघ्रमागतः॥
en: And I apprehend that voice resembling mine was heard by Vaidehī; and, despatched by her from fear, you may have come hither swiftly to see* me. Some texts-to rescue me.

sa: तदलं त्यज्यतामेष निश्चयः पापनिश्चये॥ अपि ते चरणौ मूर्धा स्पृशाम्येष प्रसीद मे। किमर्थं चिन्तितं पापे त्वया परमदारुणम्॥
en: Do you then that entertains unrighteous aims, abandon this intention of yours. I lay my head at your feet. Be propitious to me. Why does you, O sinful one, cherish in your mind such a frightful idea?

sa: सिद्धाश्रमनिवासं च राक्षसानां वधं तथा। तत्रागमनमव्यग्रं विशालायाश्च दर्शनम्॥ अहल्यादर्शनं चैव गौतमेन समागमम्। महाधनुषि जिज्ञासां कर्तुमागमनं तथा॥
en: Their sojourn in Siddhāśrama, and the slaughter there of the Raksasas, their undaunted journey, the sight of Viśālā, the encounter with Ahalyā and Gautama, Rāma's curiosity about the mighty bow, and visit there for beholding the same.

sa: यो नः सदा पालयति पिता पुत्रानिवौरसान्। कथं रघूणां स श्रेष्ठस्त्यक्त्वा नो विपिनं गतः॥
en: Why has that foremost of Raghus, who has always cherished us even as a father cherishes his sons begot by his own loins, forsaking us, betaken himself to the forest?

sa: तेषां मध्ये स्थितो राजा मेरुरुत्तमपर्वतः। आदित्येन प्रसन्नेन शैलो दत्तवरः पुरा ॥ तेनैवमुक्तः शैलेन्द्रः सर्व एव त्वदाश्रयाः। मत्प्रसादाद् भविष्यन्ति दिवा रात्रौ च काञ्चनाः॥ त्वयि ये चापि वत्स्यन्ति देवगन्धर्वदानवाः। ते भविष्यन्ति भक्ताश्च प्रभया काञ्चनप्रभाः॥
en: In the midst of them is established as king, Meru, best of mountains, formerly the Sun being well pleased, conferred a boon on this mountain, and he addressed the mountain, saying,—'By my grace all the hills that are under your protection, shall be golden day and night; and also those gods Gandharvas and Dānvas that shall dwell in you, shall be filled with reverence for me and to the boot attain a golden glory.'

sa: तेन शापं न मुञ्चामो भक्ष्यमाणाश्च राक्षसैः। तदर्घमानान् रक्षोभिर्दण्डकारण्यवासिभिः ॥ रक्षकस्त्वं सह भ्रात्रा त्वन्नाथा हि वयं वने।
en: Therefore, although afflicted and devoured by the Rākşasas dwelling in the forest of Dandaka, we do not cast our curse on them. You along with your brother are our protector: you are our master in this forest.

sa: तत्र त्वं मम नैवासि रामश्च वनमाहितः। न वनं गन्तुमिच्छामि सर्वथा हा हता त्वया॥
en: But you cease to be mine; and Rāma has been sent to the woods. I do not like to go into the forest; so I am entirely undone by you.

sa: स्थिरं नु हृदयं मन्ये ममेदं यन्न दीर्यते। प्रावृषीव महानद्याः स्पृष्टं कूलं नवाम्भसा ॥
en: Surely, I consider my heart is very hard, as it does not rend like to the bank of a great river in contact with new water in the rainy season.

sa: ये राजसूयावभृथे जलेन महाक्रतौ मन्त्रपूतेन सिक्ताः। ते पाण्डवानां परिभूय वीर्य बलात् प्रमृष्टा धृतराष्ट्रजेन॥
en: Dragging the greatly long-haired Krishna (Draupadi) as if she was protectorless, although she had great protectors, Dushasana brought her into the Sabha trembling like the banian tree in a storm.

sa: साध्वाचाराः स्त्रियो ब्रह्मन् यत् कुर्वन्ति सदाऽऽदृताः। दुष्करं खलु कुर्वन्ति पितरं मातरं च वै॥
en: O Brahmanas, what the wives of good behaviours perform carefully ſin respect to their husbands) and also what the sons do to their father and mother, are indeed, highly difficult.

sa: ऐकाग्र्यं च तथोत्साहं हयसंग्रहणं च तत्। परं यत्नं च सम्प्रेक्ष्य परां मुदमवाप ह॥
en: Also he was greatly delighted to behold the attentiveness and zeal of Bahuka, as also his manner of holding the reins and his skill in it. nin TCY ATT VTTTTTTTTTTT

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच इहाहमागतो दिष्ट्या दिष्ट्या मे सङ्गतं त्वया। ईदृशा दुर्लभा लोके नरा धर्मप्रदर्शकाः॥
en: The Brahmana said: By good luck, I have come here and by good luck I have met with you. Such expounders of religion are difficult to get in this world.

sa: ऋतुपर्ण उवाच वस बाहुक भद्रं ते सर्वमेतत् करिष्यसि। शीघ्रयाने सदा बुद्धिर्धियते मे विशेषतः॥
en: Rituparna said : O Bahuka! stay with me! All hail unto you! Shall you perform all this. Always my mind particularly turns to this, viz., to be driven very fast.

sa: विदुर उवाच जानाम्यहं द्यूतमनर्थमूलं कृतश्च यत्नोऽस्य मया निवारणे। राजा च मां प्राहिणोत् त्वत्सकाशं श्रुत्वा विद्वच्छ्रेय इहाचरस्व॥
en: Vidura said I know gambling is the root of all misery. I tried to dissuade the king from it. The king, however, has sent me to you. O learned man, knowing all this, do what is good.

sa: बन्धुवाच त्रिः सूयते कर्मणा वै प्रजेयं त्रयो युक्ता वाजपेयं वहन्ति। अध्वर्यवस्त्रिसवनानि तन्वते त्रयो लोकास्त्रीणि ज्योतींषि चाहुः॥
en: Bandi said: Three kinds of being are born as the results of their acts, Three are the Vedas that perform the Vajapeya sacrifice; at three different times the Adhvaryus commence sacrifice, three also are the divine lights.

sa: नदीः सरांसि वापीश्च विविधांश्च मृगद्विजान्। सा बहून् भीमरूपांश्च पिशाचोरगराक्षसान्॥ पल्वलानि तडागानि गिरिकूटानि सर्वशः। सरितो निर्झराश्चैव ददर्शाद्भुतदर्शनान्॥
en: Many rivers, lakes, expanses of water and various kinds of birds and beasts; large number of serpents, Rakshasas and goblins of frightful figures; and pools, tanks, mountain-peaks on all sides; and streams and cataracts of picturesque appearance.

sa: दमयन्ती तथा वाग्भिरभिनन्द्य कृताञ्जलिः। तौ परस्परतः प्रीतौ दृष्ट्वा त्वग्निपुरोगमान्॥ तानेव शरणं देवाञ्जग्मतुर्मनसा तदा।
en: Damayanti, with joined hands, showed due respect to him (Nala) by similar expressions. Thereupon the happy pair, each having seen those celestials headed by Agni, mentally prayed for their protection.

sa: अष्टावक्र उवाच नानेन जीवता कश्चिदर्थो मे बन्दिना नृप। पिता यद्यस्व वरुणो मज्जयैनं जलाशये॥
en: Ashtavakra said : O king, if Bandi remains alive, he would come to no use of mine. If his father is really Varuna, let him be drowned in the sea.

sa: अवमन्यति यः सिद्धान् क्रुद्धाश्चापि शपन्ति यम्। उन्माद्यति स तु क्षिप्रं ज्ञेयः सिद्धग्रहस्तु सः॥
en: The man who shows disrespect to the Siddhas and who is cursed by them in return soon turns mad. The evil spirit who causes this is called the Siddha spirit.

sa: यत् त्वमाभाषसे पार्थ प्राप्तः काल इति प्रभो। अनृतं नोत्सहे वक्तुं न ह्येतन्मम विद्यते॥
en: O son of Pritha, as for what you say, that “O Lord, the period is complete," I dare not tell a lie, for it never finds place in my heart.

sa: आप्यायत महातेजाः कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। धनंजयमभिप्रेक्ष्य विनीत स्थितमन्तिके॥ जटिलं देवराजस्य तपोयुक्तमकल्मषम्। हर्षेण महताऽऽविष्टः फाल्गुनस्याथ दर्शनात्॥ बभूव परमप्रीतो देवराजं च पूजयन्। तं तथादीनमनसं राजानं हर्षसम्लुतम्॥ सर्वाणि मत्तः उवाच वचनंधीमान् देवराजः पुरंदरः। त्वमिमां पृथिवीं राजन् प्रशासिष्यसि पाण्डव। स्वस्ति प्राप्नुहि कौन्तेय काम्यकं पुनराश्रमम्॥
en: Yudhishthira, the highly energetic son of Kunti seeing, that sinless and devotional Dhananjaya, bearing clotted hair, stand before the king of the gods in humility and smelling (his head), was lost in great joy, at the sight of Falguni and was exceedingly glad at worshipping the lord of the celestials. Then the intelligent king of the gods, Purandara addressed the noble-minded and exceedingly joyful king (Yudhishthira) thus, saying, “O king, O Pandava, you shall govern the earth. Let prosperity attend three, O son of Kunti, Do you return to Kamyaka.

sa: वामदेव उवाच नानुयोगा ब्राह्मणानां भवन्ति मे वाचा राजन् मनसा कर्मणा वा। स्तेन श्रेष्ठो भवति हि जीवमानः॥
en: Vamadeva said : A Brahmana can never be punished in thoughts, words or deeds. That learned man who succeeds by ascetic austerities on knowing a Brahmana to be so does not attain to prominence in this world.

sa: श्रूयते हि महाभाग बाको दाल्भ्यो महातपाः। प्रियः सखा च शक्रस्य चिरजीवी च सत्तम॥
en: “We have heard that both the high-souled Baka and Dalbha were immortal; and these (two) Rishis, held in universal reverence, were the friends of the lord of the celestial (Indra).

sa: त्वया हि मे बहु कृतं यदन्यो न करिष्यति। यद् भाहं समेष्यामि शीघ्रमेव द्विजोत्तम॥
en: O foremost of the regenerate ones, indeed you have done much for me, which none else will do; and for this reason only that I will soon regain my husband.”

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच सभां गत्वा स चोवाच द्रौपद्यास्तद् वचस्तदा। युधिष्ठिरं नरेन्द्राणां मध्ये स्थितमिदं वचः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having returned to the Sabha, he (Pratikamin) told all present there the words of Draupadi. He spoke these words to Yudhisthira sitting in the midst of the kings.

sa: प्रतस्थुर्विमले सूर्ये हिमवन्तं गिरि प्रति। इन्द्रसेनमुखांश्चापि भृत्यान् पौरोगवांस्तथा॥ सूदांश्च पारिबहाँश्च द्रौपद्याः सर्वशो नृप। राज्ञः कुलिन्दाधिपते: परिदाय महारथाः॥ पद्भिरेव महावीर्या ययुः कौरवनन्दनाः। ते शनैः प्राद्रवन् सर्वे कृष्णया सह पाण्डवाः। तस्माद् देशात् सुसंहृष्टा द्रष्टुकामाधनंजयम्॥
en: They started for the Himalaya mountain when the sun shone brightly in the sky. Having left in the care of the king of the Pulindas all their servants, Indrasena and others, also the cooks and stewards and also all accoutrements of Draupadi and also everything else, those mighty car-warriors, those greatly powerdescendants of Kuru started for that country. They proceeded cautiously with Krishna (Draupadi); they were all cheerful in the expectation of seeing Arjuna.

sa: मातरिश्वोवाच ब्राह्मणो मुखतः सृष्टो ब्रह्मणो राजसत्तम। बाहुभ्यां क्षत्रियः सृष्ट ऊरुभ्यां वैश्य एव च।॥
en: Matarishvan answered The Brahmana. O best of kings, has originated from the mouth of Brahman. The Kshatriya has originated from his two arms, and the Vaishya from his two thighs.

sa: पश्येदुपायान् विविधैः क्रियापर्थे र्न चानुपायेन मतिं निवेशयेत्। श्रियं विशिष्टां विपुलं यशो धनं न दोषदर्शी पुरुषः समश्नुते॥
en: The king should find out those means which are supplied by different kinds of acts and measures. He should never depend upon destiny. One who sees faults in innocent persons, never succeeds in acquiring prosperity and fame.

sa: ईपदुत्स्मयमास्तु भगवान् केशवोऽरिहा। परिष्वज्य च राजानं युधिष्ठिरमभाषत॥ दिष्ट्या जयसि कौन्तेय दिष्ट्याते शत्रवो जिताः। दिष्टया गाण्डीवधन्वा च भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः॥ त्वं चापि कुशली राजन् माद्रीपुत्रो च पाण्डवौ। मुक्ता वीरक्षयादस्मात् संग्रामानिहतद्विषः॥ क्षिप्रमुक्तरकालानि कुरु कार्याणि भारत। उपायतमुपप्लव्यं सह गाण्डीवधन्वना॥
en: Then, with a little pride, Lord Keshava embracing king Yudhishthira, said to him, 'By good luck, you have gained the victory, O son of Kunti! By good luck, your enemies have been defcated! By good luck, the holder of Gandiva and Bhimasena the son of Pandu, and yourself, O king, and the two sons of Madri have escaped alive from this battle so destructive of heroes, after having killed all your foes! Speedily do, O Bharata, what should now be done!

sa: घ्नन्ति चान्यान् नरा राजस्तानप्यन्ये तथा नराः। संज्ञैषा लौकिकी राजन् न हिनस्ति न हन्यते॥
en: Some, O king, kill some men. The killers, again, are slain by others. This is what the world says. In reality, however, no one kills and no one is killed.

sa: ते वयं पाण्डुपुत्रेभ्यो हीना स्म बलशक्तितः। तदत्र पाण्डवैः सार्धं सन्धिं मन्ये क्षमं प्रभो॥
en: We are now inferior to the sons of Pandu as regards the strength of our army. Therefore, O lord, I think peace with the Pandavas is conducive to our good.

sa: भ्रातृभिः सह राजेन्द्र शूरः सत्यपराक्रमः॥ मुक्तो वीरक्षयादस्मात् संग्रामाल्लोमहर्षणात्। एवमुक्तस्तु कृष्णेन धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥ हृष्टरोमा महाराज प्रत्युवाच जनार्दनम्।
en: With his brothers, O king of kings, that truly powerful hero, has come out alive of this dreadful battle, destructive of heroes.'-Thus addressed by Krishna, king Yudhishthira with his hairs standing erect, O king, said to Janarddana.

sa: धर्मतः सह स्वमेव ब्राह्मणो भुक्ते स्वं वस्ते स्वं ददाति च। गुरुर्हि सर्ववर्णानां ज्येष्ठः श्रेष्ठश्च वै द्विजः॥
en: What the Brahmana eats is his own. The place he dwells is his own. What he gives away is his own. He deserves the respect of all the (other) orders. He is the first-born and the foremost.

sa: भर्तुरर्थे च यः शूरो विक्रमेद् वाहिनीमुखे॥ न भयाद् विनिवर्तेत तस्य लोका यथा मम।
en: That hero, who, for sake of his master, shows prowess at the van of the array and does not retreat through fear, acquires those re of happiness that are mine.

sa: अमर्षितैर्ये निहताः शयाना नि:संशयं ते त्रिदिवं प्रपन्नाः। कृष्णां तु शोचामि कथं नु साध्वी शोकार्णवे साद्य विनश्यतीति॥
en: They whose bodies and now lying on the naked ground, killed by those vindictive wretches, have, forsooth, gone to heaven. I lament for the princess Krishna. Alas, she will be drowned to-day in a sea of sorrow.

sa: कर्मणा प्राप्यते स्वर्गः सुखं दुःखं च भारत। ततो वहति तं भारमवशः स्ववशोऽपि वा॥
en: By their acts they secure heaven, O Bharata, or happiness, or misery. Whether competent or otherwise, they have to bear their burdens which are the result of their own acts.

sa: बलिना विग्रहो राजन् न कदाचित् प्रशस्यते। बलिना विग्रहो यस्य कुतो राज्यं कुतः सुखम्॥१११।
en: Enmity with a powerful person, O king, is never spoken highly of. That king who has incurred the hostility of one more powerful than himself, loses both kingdom and happiness.

sa: सूत उवाच द्रौपदेया हता राजन् दुपदस्यात्मजैः सह। प्रमत्ता निशि विश्वस्ताः स्वपन्तः शिविरे स्वके॥
en: The Driver said The sons of Draupadi, O king, have been killed, with all the children of Drupada himself, while they were carelessly and trustfully asleep in their own camp.

sa: संजय उवाच अभिषिक्ते तथा शल्ये तव सैन्येषु मानद। न कर्णव्यसनं किंचिन्मेनिरे तत्र भारत॥
en: Sanjaya said After Shalya had been appointed to the command, O giver of honours, no one among your soldiers, O foremost of Bharata's race, any longer felt sorrow for Karna.

sa: ऊपश्छिन्द्यात् तु यो धेन्वाः क्षीरार्थी न लभेत् पयः। एवं राष्ट्रमयोगेन पीडितं न विवर्धते॥
en: As a person wanting milk never gets any by cutting off the udders of a cow, similarly a kingdom, assailed by improper taxes, never gives any profit to the king.

sa: शीघ्रमागच्छ भद्रं ते त्वं मे प्राणसमः सखा। तव प्राज्ञ प्रसादाद्धि प्रायः प्राप्स्यामि जीवितम्॥
en: Come quickly to me. Blessed be you, who are, indeed, a friend dear to me as life.o you of great wisdom, through your grace I have almost regained my life.

sa: दृष्टमेतत् पुरा भद्रे ज्ञातं च तपसा मया। ब्रह्मभूतं हि सकलं पितुस्तव कुलं भवेत्॥
en: It was ordained of yore by destiny, O lovely damsel. I have known it all by my penances. All the descendants of your father will be endued with Brahmanic virtues.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्र गाथा ब्रह्मगीताः कीर्तयन्ति पुराविदः। येन मार्गेण राजा वै कोशं संजनयत्युत॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding the way in which a king should fill his treasury, persons will read in the scriptures of olden days, cite the following verses sung by Brahmana himself.

sa: योऽमित्रैः सह सम्बद्धो न पौरान् बहु मन्यते। असुहृत् तादृशो ज्ञेयो न मन्त्रं श्रोतुमर्हति॥
en: One who is allied with enemies and who does not care for the interests of the king's subjects, should be regarded as an enemy. The king should never consult him.

sa: विपन्ने च समारम्भे संतापं मा स्म वै कृथाः। घटस्वैव सदाऽऽत्मानं राज्ञामेष परो नयः॥
en: Do not be sorry if what is undertaken ends disastrously, for you should then exert yourself in the same work with redoubled attention. This is the highest of royal duties.

sa: दुर्योधन महाबाहो शृणु वाक्यविदां वर। यावतौ मन्यसे कृष्णो रथस्थौ रथिनां वरौ॥ न मे तुल्याबुभावेतौ वाहुवीर्ये कथंचन।
en: "O mighty-armed Duryodhana, listen to me, O foremost of orators. You consider the two Krishnas, when on their car, as the foremost of car-warriors. They are not, however, jointly equal to me in the strength of arms.

sa: उपतस्थे च भर्तारं न चान्यं मनसाप्यगात्॥ देवं मुनि वा यक्षं वा पतित्वे पतिवत्सला।
en: Indeed, that chaste princess, devoted herself entirely to her husband and did not in her heart even desire any one else among the gods, Munis and Yakshas for a husband.

sa: ददात्यस्मद्विधोऽमात्यो बुद्धिसाहाय्यमापदि। वायसस्त्वेष मे राजन् ननु कार्याभिसंहितः॥ न च मेऽत्र भवान् गर्यो न च येषां भवान्
en: I cannot, however, blame you for this. You are not loved by those who have killed this bird. Ascertain who are your friends and who, your foes. Do everything yourself without handing over your intelligence to others.

sa: रथानां षट्सहस्राणि षट्सहस्राश्च कुञ्जराः॥ दश चाश्वसहस्राणि पत्तिकोटी च भारत। एतद् बलं पाण्डवानामभवच्छेषमाहवे॥ एत एव समाजग्मुर्युद्धाय भरतर्षभ।
en: Six thousand cars, six thousand elephants, ten thousand horse and one million of foot, O Bharata, war the remnant of the Pandava force in that battle. These, O best of Bharata's race, met each other for battle.

sa: मा स्म यज्ञकृतां प्रातिमाप्नुयां सज्जनोचिताम्। यदीमां रजनी व्युष्टां न हि हन्मि परान् रणे॥
en: Indeed I shall not enjoy the pleasure of performing sacrifices, a pleasure which is enjoyed by all pious men, if this night passes away without my killing Pandavas in battle.

sa: यदुरुवाच जरायां बहवो दोषाः पानभोजनकारिताः। तस्माजरां न ते राजन् ग्रहीष्य इति मे मतिः॥
en: Over are Yadu said: There are many inconveniences in old age about eating and drinking. Therefore, O king, I shall not take your decrepitude upon me. This is my determination.

sa: दिष्ट्या जीवन्ति ते पार्था दिष्ट्या जीवति सा पृथा। दिष्ट्या दुपदकन्यां च लब्धवन्तो महारथाः॥
en: From our good fortune the sons of Pritha are alive; from our good fortune Pritha is alive. From our good fortune those great car-warriors have obtained the daughter of Drupada.

sa: यमश्च सोमश्च महर्षयश्च साध्या विश्वे वालखिल्याश्च सर्वे। एतेऽपि यस्योद्विजन्ते प्रभावात् तस्मात् कस्मान्मादृशी नोद्विजेत॥
en: Yama, Soma, great Rishis, the Sadhyas, the Vishvedevas, the Valakhilyas, all are alarmed at the thought of his prowess. Why should not a woman (like myself) be afraid of him?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच पूरुः पितरपञ्जसा। यथाऽऽत्य मां महाराज तत् करिष्यामि ते वचः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed the king, Puru replied to him with all humility. (He said:) “O great king, I shall do as you command me to do.

sa: संरम्भो हि सपत्नीत्वाद् वक्तुं कुन्तुसुतां प्रति। यदि तु त्वं प्रसन्नो मे स्वयमेनां प्रचोदय॥
en: Kunti is my rival and therefore, I feel a delicacy in soliciting any favour from her, if you are favourably inclined towards me, ask her to grant me my desire.

sa: यत् तु कुर्यामहं राजञ्छुभं वा यदि वाशुभम्। न तद् वारयितव्यास्मि न वक्तव्या तथाप्रियम्॥
en: But O king, you must not interfere in any of my acts, whether they be agreeable or disagreeable to you. You most not also speak to me in harsh words.

sa: गन्धर्व उवाच अनग्नयोऽनाहुतयो न च विप्रपुरस्कृताः। यूयं ततो धर्षिताः स्थ माया वै पाण्डुनन्दनाः॥
en: The Gandharva said : O sons of Pandu, you do not keep fire; you have no wives; you have no Brahmanas walking before you; therefore you were censured by me.

sa: कच्चिदायस्य चार्धेन चतुर्भागेन वा पुनः। पादभागैस्त्रिभिर्वापि व्ययः संशुद्ध्यते तव॥ कच्चिज्ज्ञातीन् गुरून्वृद्धान्वणिजः शिल्पिनः श्रितान्। अभीक्ष्णमनुगृह्णासि धनधान्येन दुर्गतान्॥
en: Is your expense always covered by a half, a third of fourth part of your income? Do you always cherish with food and wealth your relatives, superiors, merchants, the old, the helpless, the protected and the distressed?

sa: ययातिरुवाच इमं भौमं नरकं क्षीणपुण्यः प्रवेष्टुमुर्वी गगनाद् विप्रहीणः। उक्त्वाहं वः प्रपतिष्याम्यनन्तरं त्वरन्ति मां लोकपा ब्रह्मणो ये॥
en: Yayati said : As I have lost my religious virtues, I am falling into the Bhauma,(earth) hell. I shall go there after finishing my talk with you. The Lokapalas are commanding me even now to hasten thither.

sa: यच्च ते प्रार्थितं ब्रह्मन् कृतं तदिति चिन्त्यताम्। दिष्ट्या प्राप्तोऽसि विप्रर्षे महान् मेऽनुग्रहः कृतः॥
en: O Brahmana, consider that to be already accomplished which is in your heart. O best of the twice born, as the fruit of our good luck we have obtained you.

sa: सुसुखा सा सदा राजन् न शीता न च धर्मदा। न क्षुत्पिपासे न ग्लानिं प्राप्य तां प्राप्नुवन्त्युत॥
en: O king, it ever contributes to the happiness of those that live within it. It is neither cold nor hot; hanger, thirst and all kinds of uneasiness disappear from one as soon as one enters into it.

sa: ते स्म तत्र यथाकामं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे दिवौकसः। प्रणम्य शिरसा तस्मै सर्वे यान्ति यथाऽऽगतम्॥
en: All the dwellers of heaven see him (Brahma) there at their pleasure, and worshipping him by bowing down their heads all go back to the place from which they come.

sa: ययातिरुवाच यत् त्वं वाचा हृदयेनापि साधून् परीप्समानान् नावमंस्था नरेन्द्र। तेनानन्ता दिवि लोकाः श्रितास्ते विद्युदूपाः स्वनवन्तो महान्तः॥
en: Yayati said: You have never disregarded either in mind or by speech the honest and the virtuous men that ever applied to you. There are infinite worlds for you to enjoy in heaven, all blazing like lightning.

sa: गनोवाच यं लेभे वरुणः पुत्रं पुरा भरतसत्तम। वसिष्ठनामा स मुनिः ख्यात आपव इत्युत॥
en: Ganga said: O best of the Bharata race, the son that was formerly born of Varuna, was the Rishi named Vasistha. He was subsequently known by the name of Apava.

sa: हंसि राक्षसवद् यस्माद् राजापसद तापसम्। तस्मात् त्वमद्यप्रभृति पुरुषादो भविष्यसि॥ मनुष्यपिशिते सक्तश्चरिष्यसि महीमिमाम्। गच्छ राजाधमेत्युक्तः शक्तिना वीर्यशक्तिना॥
en: The Rishi said: O worst of kings, as you injure an ascetic a Rakshasas, you shall from this day be a cannibal. O worst of kings, go hence. You shall wander over the world eating human flesh.

sa: ययातिरुवाच यदोऽहं तद् यदध्वं सन्तः सत्याभिनन्दिनः। अहं तन्नाभिजानामि यत् कृतं न मया पुरा॥
en: Yayati said : You are all truth-loving and wise. Give me that which I desire to have. I shall not be able to do what I have not done before.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच स्वागतं ते महाबाहो दिष्ट्या प्राप्तोऽसि मानद। अहं च कुरुराज्यं च यथेष्टमुपभुज्यताम्॥
en: Duryodhana said : "O mighty armed hero welcome to you! man deserving of politeness, I have got you by good fortune. Command me and the Kuru kingdom at your pleasure.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं सम्भाष्य तेऽन्योन्यं मन्दपालस्य पुत्रकाः। तुष्टावः प्रयता भूत्वा यथाग्निं शृणु पार्थिवः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having thus addressed one another, the sons of Mandapala then each with reverence uttered an eulogistic hymn to Agni. O king, listen to them as I recite.

sa: स हि ब्रह्मविदां श्रेष्ठो ब्रह्मास्त्रे चाप्यनुत्तमः। तस्माद् द्रोणः पराजैष्ट मां वै स सखिविग्रहे॥
en: That foremost of men, learned in the Vedas (Drona) is skilled in the Brahma weapon. Therefore, Drona has defeated me in a contest arising out of a quarrel on friendship.

sa: अष्टक उवाच यदेनसस्ते पततस्तुदन्ति भीमा भौमा राक्षसास्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्राः। कथं भवन्ति कथमाभवन्ति कथंभूता गर्भभूता भवन्ति॥
en: Ashtaka said : Why are men, when thus falling from heaven, attacked by these fearful and sharpteethed Rakshasas? Why are they not annihilated? How do they again enter the womb?

sa: सन्ति ते बहवः पुत्रा मत्तः प्रियतरा नृप। जरां ग्रहीतुं धर्मज्ञ तस्मादन्यं वृणीष्व वै॥
en: O king, you have many sons, some of them are dearer to you (than I). O virtuous man, ask some other son of yours to take upon him your decrepitude.

sa: सौतिरुवाच एवं स्तुताः सर्व एव प्रसन्ना राजा सदस्या ऋत्विजो हव्यवाहः। तेषां दृष्ट्वा भावितानीङ्गितानि प्रोवाच राजा जनमेजयोऽथ॥
en: Sauti said: Having thus adored them, Astika gratified and pleased them all, the king, the Sadasyas, the Ritvijas and the sacrificial fire. And king Janamejaya, seeing the signs and indications manifested on all sides, addressed them thus.

sa: मित्रश्च क्षुरपर्यन्तं चक्रमादाय तस्थिवान्। पूषा भगश्च संक्रुद्धः सविता च विशाम्पते॥ आत्तकार्मुकनिस्त्रिंशाः कृष्णपार्थो प्रदुद्रुवुः।
en: Mitra stood there taking up a discuss as sharp as a razor. O king, Pushkara, Bhaga and Savita. Rushed upon Partha and Krishna with bows and swords in their hands.

sa: शकुन्तलोवाच एतदाचष्ट पृष्टः सन् मम जन्म महर्षये। सुतां कण्वस्य मामेवं विद्धि त्वं मनुजाधिप।॥ कण्वं हि पितरं मन्ये पितरं स्वमजानती। इति ते कथितं राजन् यथावृत्तं श्रुतं मया॥
en: Shakuntala said: Thus the great Rishi (Kanva), when asked, told (the Brahmana) the account of my birth. O king of men, you must know that I have thus become the daughter of Kanva. Not knowing who is my real father, I regard Kanva as my father. Thus have I told you, O king, all that I heard about my birth.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच उक्तं त्वया बुद्धिमता यन्नान्यो वक्तुमर्हति। संशयानां हि निर्मोक्ता त्वन्नान्यो विद्यते भुवि॥
en: Yudhishthira said Intelligent as you are, you have said what none else is capable of saying. There is none else in the world but you who can settle all doubts.

sa: एवमुक्तो ययौ पार्थान् पुत्रेण तव सौबलः। महत्या सेनया सार्धं सह पुत्रैश्च ते विभो॥
en: Thus addressed and urged on by your son, he (Subala's son) covered in mail, proceeded against the sons of Pritha, being himself supported by your sons and a large army.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच विरोधी च कुमन्त्री च प्राज्ञमानी ममात्मजः। यस्यैव समतिक्रान्तो वधोपायो जयं प्रति॥
en: Dhritarashtra said My son in quarrelsome; his counsellors are so many fools. He is proud of his wisdom. He has thus overlooked the certain means that have given him victory.

sa: दैवमेव परं मन्ये यत् कर्णो हस्तसंस्थया। न जघान रणे पार्थं कृष्णं वा देवकीसुतम्॥
en: Indeed it is destiny that is supreme to all other forces, inasmuch as Karna did not slay cither Partha or Krishna with the dart that he had in his grasp.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नं हि विरथं हताश्वं छिन्नकार्मुकम्। शरैश्च बहुधा विद्धमस्त्रैश्च शकलीकृतम्॥ नाशकद् भरतश्रेष्ठ यतमानो महारथः।
en: O foremost of Bharatas, that great carwarrior, although striving hard, could not kill Dhristadyumna, who had his bow and car broken and horses slain and was wounded with various arrows.

sa: कृप एव च दुर्धर्षा यदि जीवति पार्थिव। यो नागात् सिन्धुराजस्य वर्त्म तं पूजयाम्यहम्॥
en: O lord of the earth, if, without following the path of the king of Sindhu, the irresistible Kripa be still alive, I praise him highly (for his escape with life).

sa: अर्जुन उवाच संशप्तकैर्युध्यमानस्य मेऽद्य सेनाग्रयायी कुरुसैन्येषु राजन्। आशीविषाभान् खगमान् प्रमुञ्चन् द्रौणिः पुरस्तात् सहसाभ्यतिष्ठत्॥
en: O king, while fighting with the Samsaptakas today, Drona's son, the leader of the Kuru army, all of a sudden came upon me discharging arrows that were like deadly serpents.

sa: तत् तदादाय चिक्षेप क्रुद्धः कर्णाय पाण्डवः। तदस्य सर्व चिच्छेद क्षिप्त क्षिप्तं शितैः शरैः॥
en: The son of Pandu then inflamed with rage, threw at Karna, everything that then came within his reach. But all those things hurled at him, Karna cut-off with sharp arrows.

sa: शत्रुजयं च विंशत्या चन्द्रदेवं तथाऽष्टभिः। मित्रदेवं शतेनैव श्रुतसेनं त्रिभिः शरै॥ नवभिर्मित्रवर्माणं सुशर्माणं तथाऽष्टभिः।
en: And Satrunjaya, with twenty arrows and also Chandradeva, with eight and Mitradeva, with one hundred and Srutasena, with three. And again, pierced Mitravarman with nine and also Susharman with eight.

sa: पश्य मे भुजयोर्वीर्यमस्त्राणं च जनेश्वर। अद्यहन्मि रणे सर्वान पञ्चालन् पाण्डुभिः सह।॥ वाहयाश्वान् नरव्याघ्र भद्रेणैव न संशयः।
en: Behold, O king, the strength of my arms and weapons. I will kill today in battle all the Panchalas and Pandavas. Drive my car, O best of men and every thing will be as I have said.”

sa: अहो बत महत् पापं कृतं कर्म सुदारुणम्। यद् राज्यसुखलोभेन द्रोणोऽयं साधु घातितः :॥
en: Alas, alas, what a heinous sin and a ruthless act have we perpetrated, for, tempted by the desire for enjoying the pleasures of sovereignty, we have slain our venerable preceptor.

sa: मित्रं मिन्देन्दतेः प्रीयतेर्वा संत्रायतेर्मिनुतेर्मोदतेर्वा॥ ब्रवीमि ते सर्वमिदं ममास्ति तचापि सर्वं मम वेत्ति राजा।
en: He is a friend who gladdens his friend, pleases him, protects him, honors him and shares in his joy. I have got all these qualities; the king himself knows it.

sa: संजय उवाच प्रायोपविष्टे तु हते पुत्र सात्यकिना तदा। सोमदत्तो भृशं क्रुद्धः सात्यकिं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Enraged at the slaughter of his son, while he was sitting with the desire of dying without food, Somadatta said these words to Satyakiक्षत्रधर्म: पुरा दृष्टो यस्तु देवैर्महात्मभिः।

sa: सेनासु सर्वासु च पार्श्वतोऽन्ये पश्चात् पुरस्ताच समन्ततश्च। मध्ये तथान्ये ज्वलिताग्निहस्ता व्यदीपयन् पाण्डुसुतस्य सेनाम्॥
en: (Innumerable) blazing lamps were placed on the flanks and the rear and the van of and within and all around the entire army. Thus were the two hosts lighted up.

sa: संजय उवाच युयुत्सुं तव पुत्रस्य द्रावयन्तं बलं महत्। उलूको न्यपतत्तूर्णं तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Then Uluka rushed most rapidly against Yuyutsu, who was routing the vast force belonging to your son; and uttered to him those words-'do you wait, do you wait.'

sa: त्रैलोक्ये यस्य चास्त्रेषु न पुमान् विद्यते समः। तं द्रोण निहतं श्रुत्वा किमकुर्वत मामकाः॥
en: In the three worlds there is no person, who is equal to him in the use of weapons. Hearing the death of this hero, Drona, what did my followers do?

sa: एतद् विस्तरशो युद्धं प्रब्रूहि कुशलो ह्यासि। न हि तृप्यामि वीराणां शृण्वानो विक्रमान् रणे॥
en: Skilled in narration as you are, recount at length the incidents of the battle to me. I am never satiated with listening to the accounts of the prowess of heroes.

sa: के रक्षन् दक्षिणं चक्र के च द्रोणस्य सव्यतः॥ के पृष्ठतश्चाप्यभवन् वीरा वीरान् विनिघ्नतः।
en: Who were they that protected the right and the left car-wheels of Drona? Who were those heroes that protected the rear of that hero when he was engaged in fighting?

sa: स्थाणुरुवाच हन्तव्याः शत्रवः सर्वे युष्माकमिति मे मतिः। न त्वेक उत्सहेहन्तुं बलस्था हि सुरद्विषः॥
en: Sthanu said My opinion is that all your enemies should be slain. Being unassisted, I cannot dare slaughter them; for really the antagonists of the celestials are all very powerful.

sa: सोऽहमद्य गमिष्यामि यत्र ते पुरुषर्षभाः। हता मदर्थे संग्रामे युध्यमानाः किरीटिना॥
en: I will today go there whither those best of the Bharatas, slain for my sake in battle by the fighting Kiriti, have gone.

sa: मिषतां योधमुख्यानां सैन्धवो विनिपातितः। पश्य राधेय पृथ्वीशाः पृथिव्यां प्रवरा युधि॥
en: And that of many other foremost warriors the king of Sindhu was killed. Behold, O son of Radha, many king-excellent warriors on earth.

sa: साग्रं शतसहस्रं तु हयानां तस्य धीमतः। सोमदत्तं महेष्वासं समन्तात् पर्यरक्षत॥
en: And gifted with wisdom and who had with him one hundred thousand steeds of best breed, completely hemmed in that mighty bowman Somadatta.

sa: प्रदुद्राव पुनर्भीता पश्यतः सव्यसाचिनः। सम्प्रभग्नं बलं दृष्ट्वा द्रोणेन निशि भारत॥
en: Again ran away in terror (even) in the very sight of Savyasachi. Seeing his lines broken by Drona at (that) night, O Bharata.

sa: तेषां शरैः स्वर्णपुङ्खः शस्त्रैश्च विविधैः शितैः। वाहनैरायुधैश्चैव सम्पूर्णा पश्य मेदिनीम्॥
en: Look! the earth is entirely filled with their gold-winged shafts, their weapons of various kinds, their beasts of burden and with their arims.

sa: तद् बाणैरर्दितं यूथं रक्षसां पीनवक्षसाम्। सिंहैरिव बभौ मत्तं गजानामाकुलं कुलम्॥
en: That great host of the broad-chested Rakshasas, sore oppressed with his arrows, looked like a herd of furious elephants attacked) by a lion.

sa: ततस्ते खड्गमुद्यम्य जिह्वां छेत्स्यामि दुर्मते॥ यचापि पाण्डवान् विप्र स्तोतुमिच्छसि संयुगे।
en: Then taking up my scimitar I will cut-off your tongue, O wretch. O Brahmana, you are desirous of praising the Pandavas, in battle.

sa: तेषामपि हताः शूराः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥ क्षीयन्ते सर्वसैन्यानि कुरूणां पाण्डवैः सह।
en: Hundreds and thousands of warriors on their side also have been destroyed. The troops of both the Kurus and the Pandavas are diminishing.

sa: यतिष्येऽहं यथाशक्ति योद्धं तैः सह संयुगे। दुर्योधनहितार्थाय 'जयो दैवे प्रतिष्ठितः'॥
en: I will confront in battle putting forth my utmost prowess for the welfare of Duryodhana. As regards success, it is dependent on fate.

sa: ततोऽसृजत् तमः कृष्णः सूर्यस्यावरणं प्रति॥ योगी योगेन संयुक्तो योगिनामीश्वरो. हरिः।
en: Thereafter that lord of the kings viz., Krishna created a veil of darkness for covering the sun, by means of his Yoga prowess.

sa: न विव्यथे सूतपुत्रो न च त्रासमगच्छत। दृष्ट्वा संहारकल्पं तमुद्भूतं सैन्यसागरम्॥
en: The charioteer's son was neither pained nor struck with terror. Beholding that wonderful army, vast as a sea and looking like Death itself.

sa: धनूंषि ते विधुन्वानाः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। अयोधयन्त राधेयं शक्रं दैत्यगणा इव॥
en: Shaking hundreds and thousands of bows, they battled with the son of Radha as the Daityas (fought with) Shakra in days of yore.

sa: अब्रवीत् पाण्डवं राजंस्त्वरमाणो जनार्दनः॥ एष मध्ये कृतः षड्भिः पार्थ वीरैर्महारथैः।
en: Janardana quickly addressing Pandu's son said-"O son of Pritha, this Jayadratha has been placed in their midst by these heroic and mighty car-warriors.

sa: न्यवर्तन्त रणाद् वीरा निराशास्तस्य जीविते॥ यो योऽभ्यधावदाक्रन्दे तावकः पाण्डवं रणे।
en: Gave up fighting, becoming hopeless of Jayadratha's life. Whoever amongst your troops then rushed to encounter the son of Pandu in that battle.

sa: दुर्योधनमिदं वाक्यं त्वरितः समभाषत॥ मयि जीवति गान्धारे न युद्धं गन्तुमर्हसि।
en: Quickly approaching Duryodhana, said these words-"O son of Gandhari so long as I am alive, it is not proper for you to fight.

sa: अश्वत्थामन् प्रसीदख नाशयैतान् ममाहितान्। तवारगोचरे शक्ताः स्थातुं देवा न दानवाः॥
en: O Ashvatthama, be gratified. Destroy my enemies. Neither the celestials nor thc Danavas are capable of staying within the range of your weapons.

sa: ततो युधि महाराज सोमदत्तो महारथः। अर्धचन्द्रेण चिच्छेद माधवस्य महद् धनुः॥
en: Then, O great monarch, in that encounter, the mighty car-warrior Somadatta cut-off with cresent-shaped arrows the great bow of the descendant of Madhu.

sa: यतते हि सदा द्रोणो ग्रहणे तव संयुगे। युद्धमस्य त्वया सह॥
en: Drona has been all along trying to capture you in battle. I do not think it proper for you to fight with him.

sa: यत्नाद् रक्षत राधेयं नाहत्वा समरेऽर्जुनम्। निवर्तिष्यति राधेय इति मामुक्तवान् वृषः॥
en: “Heedfully protect the son of Radha. Without slaying Arjuna in battle, he will not abstain. Even these words had Vrisha said to me.

sa: भीमसेनस्रिभिश्चैव पुनः पार्थश्च सप्तभिः। तान् कर्णः प्रतिविव्याध षष्ट्या षष्ट्या महारथः॥
en: Bhimasena pierced him with three and Partha again with seven arrows. Then Karna that mighty car-warrior pierced each of them with sixty shafts.

sa: तथार्जुनं च राधेयो हनिष्यति महारथः। भीमसेनमहं चापि युद्धे जेष्यामि दीक्षितः॥
en: Similarly the great car-warrior Karna will vanquish Arjuna in battle. (And) I will myself destroy Bhimasena and others clad in mail in battle.

sa: यथा गजौ हैमवतौ प्रभिन्नौ प्रवृद्धदन्ताविव वासितार्थे। तथा समाजग्मतुरुग्रवी? दनंजयश्चाधिरथिश्च वीरौ॥
en: Those two dreadful heroes Dhananjaya and Adhiratha's son encountered each other like two Himalayan elephants with full-grown tusks, madly fighting for a she-elephant.

sa: शारद्वतीसूतो राजन्नर्जुनं प्रत्यवारयत्। स विदध्वा दशभिः पार्थ वासुदेवं च सप्तभिः॥
en: Began, O monarch, to resist Arjuna. Indeed the son of the daughter of Saradvata, piercing Partha with ten shafts and Krishna with seven.

sa: अक्ष्णोनिमेषमात्रेण सोऽन्यदादाय कार्मुकम्। विव्याध पाण्डवं षष्ट्या सूतं च नवभिः शरैः॥
en: Taking up another bow in the twinkling of an eye, he pierced the son of Pandu with six and again with ten arrows.

sa: रक्षितं मद्रराजेन कृपेण च महात्मना। जयद्रथं रणमुखे कथं हन्याद् धनंजयः॥
en: How can Dhananjaya succeed in slaying in battle Jayadratha who is protected by the king of the Madras and the illustrious Kripa himself?

sa: चिच्छेद धनुषस्तूर्णं ज्यां शरेण शितेन ह। तन्निधाय धनुर्भूमौ द्रोणः क्षत्रियमर्दनः॥
en: Quickly cut-off the latter's bowstring with a short arrow; thereupon Drona that crusher of hostile Kshatriyas, throwing that bow down on the ground.

sa: कार्मुकप्रवरं चापि प्रचिच्छेद शितैः शरैः। सारथिं चास्य भल्लेन रथनीडादपातयत् ॥
en: He cut-off with sharp arrows the latter's excellent bow and then with a bhalla felled his charioteer from the niche on the car.

sa: तत्र वै देवकी देवीं वसुदेवार्थमाशु वै। निर्जित्य पार्थिवान् सर्वान् रथमारोपयच्छिनिः॥
en: In that Sayamvara, Sini having vanquished the kings, placed the princess Devaki on his car, with a view to marry her to Vasudeva.

sa: अभ्येत्य च महाबाहुः स्मयमानः च राक्षसः॥ शिरो रथेऽस्य निक्षिप्य विकृताननमूधजम्।
en: Then the mighty-armed Rakshasa, approaching the car, smilingly threw that head with contorted aspect and dishevelied hair in that car of the king.

sa: तयोः सुतुमलं युद्धं बभूव निशि रक्षसोः। अलायुधस्य चैवाग्रं हैडिम्बेश्चापि भारत॥
en: In that night the battle, that raged between the Rakshasa Alayudha and the son of Hidimba, was fierce and confused to the extreme.

sa: अस्रवेगप्रतिहता सा गदा प्रापतद् भुवि। दारयन्ती धरां देवीं कम्पयन्तीव पर्वतान्॥
en: Repulsed by the force of Baladeva's weapon, that mace fell on the earth riving her open and causing the mountains thereon to tremble.

sa: संसर्पन्तो रणे केचिन्निद्रान्धास्ते तथा परान्। जनुः शूरा रणे शूरांस्तस्मिस्तमसि दारुणे॥
en: Some heroic warriors, during that hour of darkness, though blind with sleep, yet gliding along the field, slew one another in that battle.

sa: तथैव च पुनः क्रुद्धो भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान्। वसुदानस्य भल्लेन शिरः कायादपाहरत्॥
en: Thereafter filled with rage, the puissant son of Bharadvaja, lopped off the head of Vasudana from his trunk, by means of a bhalla.

sa: यद्यदिवसं द्रोणो युध्यते मन्युमास्थितः। सत्यं ब्रवीमि ते सेना विनाशं समुपैष्यति॥
en: "If influenced by rage Drona fights only for half a day, then I tell you truly, your troops are sure to be destroyed.

sa: कौमारे यानि वृत्तानि विप्रियाणि विशाम्पते। तानि सर्वाणि चाप्येव रूक्षाण्यश्रावयद् भृशम्॥
en: O monarch, he was also reminded by Karna in harsh language, of all the wrongs done to him in his days of childhood.

sa: तावका निहते द्रोणे गतासव इवाभवन्। पराजयमथावाप्य परत्र च महद् भयम्॥
en: Upon the death of Drona, your troops appeared to be senseless. Having suffered a defeat and being inspired with fear about the future.

sa: स मुहूर्तात् पुनः संज्ञां लेभे कर्णः परंतपः। रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्ग क्रोधमाहारयत् परम्॥
en: But within a moment, that afflicter of foes Karna regaining his senses, found his body steeped in blood and became furious with rage.

sa: यथा शिलोच्चये शैलः सागरे सागरो यथा। प्रतिहन्येत राजेन्द्र तथाऽऽसन् कुरुपाण्डवाः॥
en: The collision between the Kurus and the Pandavas was like that between a mountain against a mountain or an ocean against an Ocean.

sa: प्रादुरासंस्ततो बाणा दीप्ताग्राः खे सहस्रशः। पाण्डवान् क्षपयिष्यन्तो दीप्तास्याः पन्नगा इव॥
en: Then thousands of arrows with blazing tips appeared in the welkin looking like snakes of fiery mouth, that continued to agitate the Pandavas.

sa: आपूयर्ममाणेनास्त्रेण सैन्ये क्षीयति च प्रभो। जगाम परमं त्रासं धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: The very virtuous king Yudhishthira was filled with fear, as his army became reduced in number and that weapon swelled in its fury.

sa: अन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय भीमं विव्याध पत्रिभिः। तौ द्रौणिभीमौ समरे पराक्रान्तौ महाबलौ॥
en: Took up another and pierced Bhima with winged shafts. Then Drona's son and Bhima, both valourous and possessed of might, in that battle.

sa: तदिदं निहते द्रोणे विषण्णमिव लक्ष्यते। युध्यमानाश्च समरे योधा वध्यन्ति सर्वशः॥
en: But you, however, look very cheerless (dispirited) now in the death of Drona. All the warriors engaged in battle are slain in battle.

sa: दुःशासनश्च निहतः पाण्डवेन यशस्विना। पीतं च रुधिरं कोपाद् भीमसेनेन संयुगे॥
en: Dusshasana, too, was slain in an encounter by Bhimasena, that famous son of Pandu, who had drunk his (Dusshasana's) blood out of anger.

sa: सिधुराष्ट्रमुखानीह दश राष्ट्राणि यानिह। वशे तिष्ठन्ति वीरस्य यः स्थितस्तव शासने॥ अक्षौहिणीर्दशैकां च विनिर्जित्य शितैः शरैः। अर्जुनेन हतो राजन् महावीर्यो जयद्रथः॥
en: That heroic leader, under whose control ten kingdom remained, the foremost of which was the kingdom of Sindhu; and who, again, was under your subjection-that one Jayadratha, O monarch, of mighty prowess, was slain by Arjuna, after he had subdued eleven Akshauhinis by his sharp arrows.

sa: तथैव रथिनां श्रेष्ठः क्षेम धूर्तिर्विशाम्पते। निहतो गदया राजन् भीमसेनेन संयुगे॥
en: So also, O ruler of earth, Kshemadhurti, that best of the car-warriors, was slain by Bhimasena in battle by means of his mace.

sa: प्रगृह्य च महाशक्तिं कालशक्तिमिवापराम्। समुत्क्षिप्य च राधेयः संधाय च महाबलः॥
en: Taking up that fierce lance that resembled a second dart of Death and tilting it and aiming it, the powerful son of Radha.

sa: एतदाचार्यतनयाच्छ्रुत्वा राजंस्तवात्मजः। आशा बहुमती चक्रे कर्णं प्रति स वै तदा॥
en: O king, having heard these (words) from the son of the preceptor, then your son had entertained great hopes in respect to Karna.

sa: पराजित्य रणे तं तु कौरव्यं पाण्डुनन्दनः। दुर्योधनबलं दृष्ट्वा प्रममाथ समन्ततः॥
en: Having defeated that Kuru warrior in battle, the son of Pandu looked at the army of Duryodhana and crushed it on all sides.

sa: एकस्य च बहूनां च संनिपातो महाहवे॥ विशेषतो नरपतेर्विषमः प्रतिभाति मे।
en: That battle between the one and the many, that one again being a king by birth, seems to me to be very unfair.

sa: नकुलस्तु ततः कर्णं विद्ध्वा सप्तभिराशुगैः। अथास्य धनुषः कोटि पुनश्चिच्छेद मारिष॥
en: Thereupon Nakula, indeed, after having penetrated Karna with seven impetuous arrows, once more severed one of the horns of his bow, O sire.

sa: व्यायुधं चैनमालक्ष्य शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥ आर्पयद् बहुभिः कर्णो न चैनं समपीडयत्।
en: On seeing him (his antagonist) without any weapons, Karna afflicted him with numerous straight arrows; but he did not oppress him too severely.

sa: सारथिं च सुसंक्रुद्धः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। ततोऽस्य वाहान निशितैः शरैर्जने महारथः॥
en: Then that mighty car-warrior, highly inflamed with rage, slew Dushasana's steeds with sharp arrows and his charioteer with numerous shafts of depressed knots.

sa: तेषु द्रवत्सु राजेन्द्र पुत्रो दुःशासनस्तव। तस्थौ व्यपेतभी राजन् सात्यकिं चार्दयच्छरैः॥
en: Stood fearlessly before Satyaki afflicting him with his arrows. He then pierced the latter's charioteer with three and his steeds with four arrows;

sa: संजय उवाच ततो दुःशासनो राजशैनेयं समुपाद्रवत्। किरशतसहस्त्राणि पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिमान्॥
en: Sanjaya said Meanwhile, o king, Dushasana advanced upon the grandson of Sini, shooting thousands of arrows, like a mighty rain-clouds pouring its contents.

sa: शकुनिर्दुःसहश्चैव युवा दुर्धर्षण: ऋथः। अन्ये च बहवः शूराः शस्त्रवन्तो दुरासदाः॥
en: Shakuni, Dussaha, the youthful Durmarsana, Kratha and many other brave warriors, all well-versed in the use of weapons and difficult of being defeated.

sa: ते सात्यकिमपास्याशु राजन् युधि महारथाः। यतो द्रोणस्ततः सर्वे सहसा समुपाद्रवन्॥
en: O king, then all those mighty car-warriors, leaving Satyaki in battle, proceeded to the spot where Drona was carried away by his horses.

sa: ततः शल्याश्रित दृष्ट्वा कर्णः स्वं रथमुत्तमम्॥ अध्यतिष्ठद् यथाम्भोदं विद्युत्वन्तं दिवाकरः।
en: Beholding Shalya stationed there Karna got upon his most excellent car like the sun riding on a mass of clouds charged with lightning.

sa: ताभ्यां यदकृतं वीर वीरकर्म महामृधे॥ तत् कर्म कुरु राधेय वज्रपाणिरिवापरः।
en: Like the second wielder of thunderbolt do you accomplish that heroic feat in the great battle which had not been performed by them.

sa: मायायुद्धेषु कुशलौ मायायुद्धमयुध्यताम्। यां यां घटोत्कचो युद्धे मायां दर्शयते नृप॥
en: Those two Rakshasas, versed in illusive combats, fought on displaying illusions O king; and in in that that battle whatsoever illusions Ghatotkacha created.

sa: रथातिरथसंख्यायां यत् त्वां भीष्मस्तदाब्रवीत्। तान् विदित्वाऽऽत्मनो दोषान् निर्मन्युभव मा क्रुधः॥४
en: Remembering your faults that were recited by Bhishma before the assembled car-warriors and mighty car-warriors drive away your anger and be not angry.

sa: ततः कर्णो महाराज रोषामर्षसमन्वितः॥ पाण्डवं पञ्चविंशत्या नाराचानां समार्पयत्। आजघ्ने बहुभिर्बाणैर्ध्वजमेकेषुणाहनत्॥
en: Thereupon O great king, filled with anger and revenge Karna discharged twenty-five Narachas at Bhima. With one arrow he then cut-off Bhima's standard.

sa: रथबन्धमिमं घोरं पृथिव्यां नास्ति कश्चन। यः सहेत पुमाँल्लोके मदन्यो यदुपुङ्गव॥
en: O foremost of Yadus, there is none on earth, save myself who is capable of bearing such a close attack on his car."

sa: एवमुक्तो महाराज द्रोणपुत्रः स्मयन्निव॥ युक्तं तत्त्वं च संचिन्त्य नोत्तरं किंचिद्ब्रवीत्।
en: Thus addressed, O monarch, the son of Drona smiled bashfully and pondering over what was proper and meet could not give any reply.

sa: सर्वे द्रोणरथं प्राप्य पञ्चालाः पाण्डवैः सह। तदनीकं बिभित्सन्तो महास्त्राणि व्यदर्शयन्॥
en: Then all the Panchalas accompanied by the Pandavas, reaching Drona's chariot, displayed many mighty weapons, with a view to break through Drona's array.

sa: स दृष्टैव तु दासार्ह स्यन्दनस्थं विशाम्पते। पुनः प्रासृजदुग्राणि शरवर्षाणि मारिष॥
en: Again, O king, as soon as he saw the Dasarha on the car he began to discharge his terrible shafts much more quickly.

sa: निवृत्तं पश्य कौन्तेय भीमसेनं युधां पतिम्॥ आशीविषमिव क्रुद्धं द्रावयन्तं वरूथिनीम्।
en: Behold, O son of Kunti, Bhimasena, the commander of your army, worked up with anger like a serpent, is assailing the (Kuru) troops.

sa: ततः स पार्षतः क्रुद्धो धनुश्चिच्छेद मारिष। क्षुरप्रेण सुतीक्ष्णेन तत उचुक्रुशुर्जनाः॥
en: Then worked up with anger Prisata's son cut-off his bow with a sharp razor shaped arrow at which all his people shouted out.

sa: धनुरुयाच्छिनत् तूर्णं हस्तावापं च वीर्यवान्। रथं च शकलीकर्तुं सव्यसाची प्रचक्रमे।॥
en: Then that highly powerful hero cut-off the latter's bow and the leathern gloves quickly. Savyasachin then began to cut his car into fragments.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महाराज सूतपुत्रः प्रतापवान्॥ प्रगृह्य विजयं वीरो धनुः श्रेष्ठं पुरातनम्। सज्यं कृत्वा महाराज संगृह्य च पुनः पुनः॥ संनिवार्य च योधान् स सत्येन शपथेन च। प्रायोजयदमेयात्मा भार्गवास्त्रं महाबलः॥
en: Having said this, O monarch, the charioteer's son, highly powerful as he was, took up his old victorious bow Vijaya the best of its kind and rubbing again and again its string set it on the bow. Thereupon having assured his army and commanded them to wait in the battle-field, the powerful and highly energetic Karna set Bhargava weapons to his bow-string.

sa: द्रोणेन विद्धोऽतिभृशं तरस्वी। तस्थौ स तत्रापि जयप्रतीक्षो द्रोणोऽपियावन्न हत: किलासीत्॥
en: Although struck greatly with sharpened arrows by Drona's son the king still waited in the battle-field, desirous of victory, until Drona was slain.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच चोदयाश्वान् हृषीकेश विहायैतद् बलार्णवम्। अजातशत्रु राजानं द्रष्टुमिच्छामि केशव॥
en: Arjuna said “Leave this ocean-like army, O Hrishikesha and drive the horses. I wish to see, OKeshava, the king who has no enemies."
